text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Phew! My throat is wiped! I need to take a break from all this singing.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'm such an amazing singer! It's a shame no one's around to hear this.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Aw, come on! I wanna sing some more!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wait… Wasn't I supposed to train today?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh well! I need a break from time to time. 'Sides, I'm already the best anyways! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'll text everyone to see if they're up for some singing and dancing at this karaoke joint!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, hello? Yes, I'd like to extend my time, please! By a lot!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe! It's all coming together! Today's gonna be so fun!
